_: Factorio's recipes that are not named after one item: they make a fluid, several things at once, or one thing that several recipes make. reference/factorio/recipes.json is keyed by product and cannot carry them, so these are transcribed from Wube's data/base/prototypes/recipe.lua, in the same units - time in seconds, amounts in items or fluid units - and every id here is resolved through data/mapping.json's items table exactly as the dump's are. tools/gen_recipes.py turns them into facraft recipes with fluid ingredients and fluid results; tools/gen_technologies.py resolves a technology that unlocks one to its recipe key, <owner>:<id with underscores>. Never edit the numbers: they are the spec, the same as the dump's.
_category: Factorio's recipe category, which is the machine that runs it: oil-processing is the refinery's, chemistry the chemical plant's. A recipe here always has one, because every one of them takes or makes a fluid and the hand has no pipes.
_missing: coal-liquefaction (10 coal, 25 heavy oil, 50 steam -> 90 heavy oil, 20 light oil, 10 petroleum gas, 5 s) is left out until production science exists: its technology needs it, and a recipe no technology names is free from the first tick. The barrel recipes wait on a machine that fills them.
